purpose: Minimal smoke set for figure-to-data: 5 data-bearing figures, 2+ with sub-panels, raster and vector, five chart kinds.

figures.expected_kind: stacked_bar (horizontal), single panel, raster, printed % on the 'Correct' segment of each of 24 bars, 6 series
figures.truth_hint: printed labels; the paper text states deltas +8.0, +29.3, -15.2 pp; 22/24 labels are k/138

figures.expected_kind: line charts, 2x2 panels a-d, raster, 13 categorical x ticks (temperature), average line with min-max band
figures.truth_hint: no printed values; read averages at each tick by eye against the y grid (25..91 step ~8.3); mark confidence accordingly

figures.expected_kind: panel a: 3x3 grid of grouped bar charts with error bars (5 methods each); panel b: 3 stacked bar charts with printed %; raster
figures.truth_hint: panel b values are printed; panel a values read by eye against the 0.2-0.8 axis; include err_lo/err_hi

figures.expected_kind: Extended Data Fig. 2: 3x5 grid of line charts (retrieval metrics and win rates vs prompt tokens, log2 x axis), 3 series with 95% CI bands, star markers and dotted baselines; RASTER (one 3661x2460 bitmap), BiomedCLIP mislabels it forest_plot
figures.truth_hint: no printed values; truth read from pixels against gridlines and tick glyphs (334 rows, confidence 0.6-0.9)

figures.expected_kind: three pie charts (a, b, c: clinician survey responses), 5 slices each with printed percentages, vector wedges (BiomedCLIP says bar_chart 0.97)
figures.truth_hint: printed percentages are the truth; wedge arc angles reproduce them to 0.1 pp

fallbacks.expected_kind: 3x5 grid of 2-series line charts (AMIE vs PCP over visits 1-3), vector
